scope: R02/R06/R09 and backend part of R20; working source, not installed/public artifact

changes.R02: Persisted stateRevision + full-set CAS, strict narrow settings/node IPC; serialization covers login side effects, rollback and disk publication.
changes.R06: Confirmed subscription ID removal and node changes atomically apply to latest state; pending refresh cannot resurrect removed or same-URL-replaced ID.
changes.R09: DNS path/query/credentials/hash, URI, secret object fields, quoted assignments and incomplete/long private key blocks concealed in diagnostic export and central logs.
changes.R20: shield saveConnected persists only selected zapretProfile and preserves explicit GUI startup preferences.

limits: R06 selected panel/confirmation renderer is owned by UI agent and requires integrated validation.
R20 main login coercion/startup implementation is owned by root; this receipt proves the backend saveConnected callback only.
SCM, boot without GUI, installed updater migration, signed release and months-long uptime are not proved by these tests.
Managers/health status and Electron login/transport dependencies were controlled fixture leaves; native state store/export ZIP functions ran on own files.
Revision/CAS covers the one application process mutation queue; it is not a multi-process state-file lock.
Login rollback is attempted in the serialized mutation; native login readback/rollback failures remain a Windows integration check.
Central JS logs and the current five-entry diagnostics archive are covered; external runtime/Core logs and all possible secret encodings are not claimed clean.
